docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Bose’s account of the principles of Indian architecture and sculpture, with the Sanskrit text of the Mayaśāstra and an English summary (Lahore, 1926). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Principles Of Indian Silpasastra · Bose Phanindra Nath · 1926, 132 scanned pages. Published 1926; Phanindra Nath Bose died 1932 and the foreword writer James H. Cousins 1956; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
